note: 22-acre wooded campground in the Ozark hills near Tecumseh, about 1.2 km from the Norfork Lake boat ramp; stone cabins, clubhouse, disc golf and walking trails on site. --Claude
summary: Confirmed $40 base (30A W/E, 4 people), $45 50A, water/no sewer, 20 RV pads (operator map), reservable by phone/email; added 50A, dump station, weekly rates in fees.note. Pin ~220 m W of the loop: flagged. Not waterfront kept.
flags: GATE FACTS (private): rate $40 (30A W/E) / $45 (50A) on the operator's own page - under $50, no gateway needed; Good Sam: not in the directory within 2.5 km (not a GS Park); presence passes - working operator site with phone (417) 679-0149 / (417) 989-0668 and email, Google Maps 4.9 stars / 147 reviews with the same phone; RV Life 4.5 stars, $$.

RATE DATE: the reservations page carries no year (the home-page notice 'we are turning water back on tomorrow, March 1st' is undated too); read as current 2026-11-07, matching the figures read 2026-10-16.

LONG-STAY TESTS (weekly rates are marketed): (1) nightly rates posted and sold to the public - pass; (2) posted nightly rate $40/$45 - pass; (3) long-term share - the operator's map marks 3 of 20 RV pads 'Long Term Camper' (15%), and leaf-off imagery (winter, off-season) shows about 7 RVs parked, a share consistent with a few long-termers plus cabins; (4) reviews read are transient - vacation and family trips, cabins last minute, 'tucked away in the hills and nice and quiet', a 2019 Tripadvisor cabin stay; none mention residents or workers; (5) no monthly or seasonal rate marketed, weekly only. Read as a transient campground: keep. Reviews were read in Google's relevance order (Newest sort failed to load).

PIN: stored 36.5862,-92.3065 sits on the outbuildings by Hwy 160, ~220 m W of the campground loop on imagery. Suggest 36.5866,-92.3043 (centre of the RV loop; clubhouse at 36.5862,-92.3048). Google's pin 36.5854,-92.3054 is south of the highway.

WATERFRONT not waterfront kept: wooded hilltop loop; the operator says '3/4 of a mile from the Norfork Lake boat ramp', and the North Fork of the White River is miles off ('We are 6 miles from Patrick Bridge'). No water on imagery.
Phone: stored 417-679-0149 matches the operator; the page also lists a second line, 417-989-0668.

FACILITIES: showers not written - the operator's pages don't state them (only a 2019 Tripadvisor review on Google: 'I was just 50 steps from the showers'); the map shows restroom symbols on the clubhouse.
